domain: AGI Compute Infrastructure & Critical Mineral Chokepoints

macro_convergence.geopolitical_framework: Critical Minerals Export Controls & Grid Power Capacity
macro_convergence.asset_class: Rare Earth Elements / Utility Infrastructure / AI Hardware Debt
macro_convergence.chokepoint: Power Transformers / Heavy Rare Earth Supply Lines (Terbium/Dysprosium)

key_findings: Severe energy bottlenecks constraining hyper-scale AGI Data Center expansion across North America and EU.
Export restrictions on key heavy rare earths and processing technologies increasing hardware procurement lead-times.
Capital allocation shift toward captive power generation assets (nuclear/gas microgrids) to bypass utility queue delays.
hedging_action: Hedge exposure on utility infrastructure providers; prioritize capital allocation to vertically integrated energy-compute assets.
